question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

I want you to ________ an investigation into this matter.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**set**" means to establish or initiate something. (स्थापित करना)
 
• In this context, **"set an investigation"** means to initiate or start the process of investigating. (जांच स्थापित करना)
 
• The other options: "**take**," "**open**," and "**free**" **do not fit the context as appropriately.**

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I want you to **set**__ an investigation into this matter.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Take (लेना)**: To gain possession or control of something.

 
 
• **Example:** She asked him to take the necessary steps to resolve the issue.
 
 
 
• **Open (खोलना)**: To make something accessible or available.
 
 
• **Example:** They decided to open the new store next month.
 
 
 
• **Free (मुक्त करना)**: To release from confinement or bondage.
 
 
• **Example:** The prisoners were set free after the court's verdict.
